canonical_name: Integral singular homology is invariant under homeomorphism
canonical_statement: For every natural-number degree n, topological spaces X and Y, and homeomorphism e : X ≃ₜ Y, the map on integral singular homology induced by e is an isomorphism.

canonical_formal_target.elaborated_expression: ∀ (n : ℕ) (X Y : TopCat) (e : ↑X ≃ₜ ↑Y), IsIso (((singularHomologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat n).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of ℤ)).map (TopCat.isoOfHomeo e).hom)

domain_and_universes: n : ℕ; X Y : TopCat at the default universe selected by the checked declaration; integral coefficients are the object AddCommGrpCat.of ℤ
hypotheses: e is a homeomorphism from X to Y
conclusion: The morphism obtained by applying the degree-n integral singular-homology functor to TopCat.isoOfHomeo(e).hom has a CategoryTheory.IsIso instance.
excluded_degenerate_cases: None: n = 0 and empty spaces are included and checked by StatementBoundary.lean.
